messages:
ana: Quick design check — riffing on the regression lanes view: current 'Approve' sits inline with each diff row. feels noisy when you have 20 small diffs. suggestion: move primary CTA to the top toolbar and replace row-level button with a lighter 'mark reviewed' affordance.
kevin: +1 to reducing per-row weight. top-level CTA could be 'Approve selected' and disabled unless rows selected. avoids accidental bulk approves.
lisa: Accessibility note: if we move CTA to toolbar we need a clear focus order. keyboard users should be able to tab into lane, use space to select, then tab to toolbar and activate. also announce count: "Selected 3 of 12" to SR.
devon: UX nit on copy — current confirmation modal says "Are you sure?" which is vague. recommend: title: "Approve N changes" body: "This will mark N outputs as accepted for this eval run. This action is reversible from history." primary: "Approve N outputs" secondary: "Cancel". keeps verbs explicit.
ana: @lisa can you mock the SR text? we can use it in dev PR.
lisa: sure, quick draft: "Dialog title: Approve 3 outputs" "Status line (aria-live): 3 outputs selected — press Enter to approve or Esc to cancel". also include role="alert" on success toast: "3 outputs approved — undo" with a visible Undo button.
kevin: question: do we want per-output granularity in undo? or only bulk undo? bulk seems simpler but per-output could be noisy. thoughts?
devon: per-output undo could clutter timeline. keep single undo for bulk action, but in history show per-output timestamps so you can revert individually via the run detail page.
ana: design-bot generated color contrast test for the 'Approve' primary — current blue (#1a73e8) hits 3.8:1 on small text. we need 4.5:1 for buttons with text <18px. either darken or increase text weight.
lisa: let's darken to #0f5bb5 for the CTA, and drop a 1px outline on keyboard focus. also add visible focus ring that isn't just color (for users who rely on shape).
kevin: another flow concern — regression diffs can be large. propose a 'compact view' toggle that collapses unchanged context and shows inline expand for changed chunks. default to compact for runs with >10 diffs.
devon: compact view good. but ensure chevrons have aria-expanded and a target hit area >= 44px. mobile check.
lisa: copy tweak for scorecard badges: instead of "Pass / Fail" use "Meets threshold / Needs review" — less binary, more action-oriented.
nana: approval microcopy proposal (single line): "Approving marks these outputs as validated for this eval run. Use Undo in the top-right toast within 10s."
kevin: small frontend note: we should debounce the top-level 'Approve selected' if someone spams Enter. 500ms throttle.
devon: putting this together for the PR: I'll update the toolbar markup, aria-live region, focus order, and toast copy. can we get a quick sign-off from design on the copy and contrast before I ship?
lisa: sign-off on copy & contrast from design: approved pending small spacing tweak on toolbar (increase gap between select-count and actions).
nana: I'll add the contrast change and spacing tokens to the token PR.
kevin: one last ask — when a run has a mixed set of model variants, show a tiny variant pill per row (hover reveals full model name) so approvers can spot variant regressions. keep pill subtle (12px height).
lisa: love the variant pill idea. ensure it has tooltip accessible via keyboard (focusable).
ux-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled 2024-11-07 10:00am PT with eng and design. Agenda: toolbar relocation, compact view, accessibility checklist, undo behaviour.
nana: thanks all — I'll compile notes and post a follow-up with annotated mocks. :thumbsup:
